_comment: Citations in docs/v2.0-roadmap.md that tools/check_roadmap_claims.py judges
and that are STALE. This is debt, not an exception. The allow-list beside it
says 'the citation is right and the tree is the wrong place to look'; an
entry here says 'the citation is wrong and the roadmap has to be edited'.
It exists because issue #1233 widened the path rule from 79 judged citations
to 498 in one change, and a widening that reds the branch it lands on gets
reverted instead of paid down. Every entry names the sentence and the edit
that clears it.
HOW IT SHRINKS, which is the only thing that makes a ratchet different from
a permanent exemption:
* `count` restates the number of entries and the loader refuses the file
when the two disagree, so debt cannot be added or dropped without a
visible diff to a number;
* an entry that stops matching is reported by the checker and FAILS
tests/test_roadmap_claims_gate.py, so correcting the roadmap sentence
forces the entry out and the count down. tools/affected_tests.py selects
that test on any edit to docs/v2.0-roadmap.md, so the commit that pays
the debt is the commit that runs the check;
* at zero entries this file is deleted. A missing file is an empty
ratchet, so nothing else has to change.

entries.verdict: cites `canonical_echoer/aggregates/service.core.wat`, which is not a file in the tree
entries.fix: Item 432(e) says the hunk moved goldens `in all four` and then names three of them with slashes used as an alternation, which reads as one path and is none. The three files are backends/wasm/golden/canonical_echoer.core.wat, canonical_aggregates.core.wat and canonical_service.core.wat. Spell them out, or write canonical_{echoer,aggregates,service}.core.wat, and this entry and the count go with the edit.
